description:
Ramaneswaram -Shiva Shakthi Shirdi Sai Anugraha Mahapeetam is a tourist destination that connects devotees with Lord Shiva, Goddess Shakthi and Shirdi Sai.
This is a Golden Shivalingam Temple, alongside 1008 Shivlings and many more deities.
